whatItDoes: Adds text and/or logo watermarks to images via canvas. Text controls: content, font size 10–120, color, opacity 0–100, sans/serif/mono, bold/italic, rotation −180–180. Logo controls: upload PNG/JPEG/WebP, scale 5–100%, opacity. Position via 3×3 grid plus offset X/Y and optional tiled repeat across the image. Output to JPEG/PNG/WebP.
whyItExists: Protecting photos and branding content normally requires cloud editors that see your images. This tool composites watermarks locally with precise position, tiled repeat, and rotation, so you can batch-protect images without uploading them.
whoShouldUse: Photographers adding copyright, marketers stamping logos on campaign images, and anyone needing quick, private watermarking without Photoshop.
useCases: Add © 2026 text at bottom-right with 60% opacity to a portfolio photo
Overlay a PNG logo at center with 80% opacity for product shots
Tile a semi-transparent text watermark diagonally across an image to deter copying
Rotate a text watermark −30° for a classic stock-photo look before download
instructions: Drop a base image (JPEG/PNG/WebP, 10MB) — it appears in the preview canvas scaled to max 2000px.
Optionally drop a logo image (PNG with transparency recommended) in the second zone.
Set text, font size, color, opacity, family, bold/italic, rotation. Set logo scale/opacity if a logo is loaded.
Pick a position from the 3×3 grid (top-left … bottom-right), adjust offset X/Y, enable Tiled to repeat across the image.
Choose output format (JPEG/PNG/WebP + quality) and click Download. Preview updates live (100ms debounce) and never uploads.
examples: Input: 2000×1500 base, text '© DevStackIO' 32px white 60% at bottom-right → Output: watermarked JPEG, text composited via fillText with globalAlpha.
Input: base + logo PNG scaled 20% at center tiled → Output: logo repeated in a grid with rotation −30°, each tile drawn with translate/rotate/drawImage.
bestPractices: Use PNG logos with transparency for clean overlay; JPEG logos will have a solid background
Keep text opacity 40–70% for visibility without obscuring the photo
For tiled watermarks, use a moderate rotation (−30°) and 60–80px spacing for even coverage
commonMistakes: Setting logo scale 100% on a large logo — it will be auto-fit to 90% of canvas; start at 20%
Forgetting tiled repeats on large images — enable Tiled to cover the whole canvas, not just one placement
Expecting EXIF to persist — the output is a new bitmap without original metadata
faq: Is the image uploaded? No — watermarking is canvas-only in your browser. Images never leave your device.
What formats are supported? Base: JPEG/PNG/WebP; Logo: PNG/JPEG/WebP. Output: JPEG/PNG/WebP with quality control (PNG ignores quality).
Can I use both text and logo? Yes — they composite in order: base → text (or tiled text) → logo (or tiled logo) with separate opacities.
How is position calculated? From the 3×3 grid anchor plus offset X/Y. Tiled ignores position and repeats in a grid with rotation applied per tile.
features: Text watermark with font, color, opacity, rotation
Logo watermark with scale and opacity
